⚖️ Flat vs Reducing Rate Calculator

Compare a flat-rate loan against a reducing-balance loan — flat rates always cost more than they appear.

📊 The Real Cost of a Flat Rate

A 8% flat rate is actually equivalent to a reducing-balance rate of ~15.7%

💡 Flat-rate interest is charged on the full original principal for the entire tenure, even as you repay it. That makes a "cheap-looking" flat rate roughly 15.7% in effective terms — nearly double the stated rate.
Flat Rate — Total Payment₹7,00,000
Reducing Rate — Total Payment₹6,67,333

🔥 Inflation-Adjusted Value

₹6,67,333 in 5 years won't have the same purchasing power as today. Here's what it's really worth in today's money.

Nominal (Future) Value₹6,67,333
Inflation-Adjusted Value (Today)₹4,87,074
Purchasing power erosion: 27.0% (₹1,80,259) over 5 years due to inflation.
